screens.title: Conversations · Sharma Traders
screens.caption: A dealer asks "order kab aayega?" at 9 pm. The bot answers from the live order — dispatch time, LR number, ETA — in Hinglish, and knows when to hand over.

screens.title: Today
screens.caption: What the bot handled today, what it handed over, and the questions it couldn't answer — each one a gap in the knowledge base you can close in a minute.

screens.title: Knowledge
screens.caption: The bot answers only from sources you approve — the live ERP, your price list, your policies — and shows which source every answer came from.

screens.title: Handovers
screens.caption: Handover is a feature, not a failure: price, complaints, frustration, VIP dealers and anything unknown go to a named person with the thread summarised.

screens.title: Flows · New dealership enquiry
screens.caption: Structured flows for the questions that need a shape — a new dealer enquiry, a complaint with a photo, a reorder — mixed with free conversation where a script would be annoying.

screens.title: Reports
screens.caption: What the bot saved: after-hours questions answered, calls not made to the sales desk, and the questions that keep coming back.

screens.title: Dealer side
screens.caption: A complaint with a photo: the bot logs it against the delivery, asks the two questions dispatch needs, and hands over with everything attached — no "please call our office".
